_source: The Flight design document pp. 35-36 (the long match: the seasons, what they change and reward, their events) and p. 49 (pacing). Days are game days (2 real minutes each, the user's call), so a four-season match is 16 days.
_days_note: The user (2026-10-03): the expected game may run more days to fit the progression. The colony grows about 1.6x slower in days than the doc's targets, so the doc's day numbers are stretched by about 1.5: seasons of 5-7 days, a four-season match of 24 days (48 real minutes), perks at days 5, 11 and 17.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.sea: Fish rise to the shallows; lagoons are full; mates are plentiful
seasons.rewards: Growth: nests, clutches, the first fishers
seasons.event_what: Every ground doubles for a day; the sharks sleep

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.sea: Grounds thin near islands; the blue is rich; thermals all day
seasons.rewards: Expansion, trade, the first wars; Bombers fly cheap on thermals
seasons.event_what: A school of big fish crosses the map in a day: whoever follows it eats for a week

seasons.name: Autumn
seasons.sea: Storms; grounds shift; the kraken wakes more
seasons.wind: Gales from one quarter for a day at a time
seasons.rewards: Caches (the smokehouse matters), sieges, raids under fog
seasons.event_what: Every wild bird on the map flies through: mates are free for a day, and so is conversion

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.sea: Fish go deep (Deep Dive pays); the lagoons freeze on northern maps
seasons.rewards: Holding what you have; the deciding war; the score (Winter's holdings count double)
seasons.event_what: One game day of darkness: Watchers and Shadow colonies own it

_decrees_source: Doc pp. 36-38: at dawn every game day of a long match the player picks one decree from three offered, drawn from a deck of 24 with no repeats in a match. It lasts the day. Each decree's numbers are its effect and its trade-off; 'tomorrow' numbers apply the day after.

decrees.name: Full Nets
decrees.effect: Fishers +30% catch

decrees.name: Quiet Wings
decrees.effect: No splash, no noise; raids are silent

decrees.name: Feast Day
decrees.effect: Chicks grow a full day in half

decrees.name: Hatching Moon
decrees.effect: Eggs hatch today regardless of warmth

decrees.name: Call to Arms
decrees.effect: Every adult becomes a warrior for the day (Skirmisher stats)

decrees.name: Builders' Day
decrees.effect: Build speed; twigs cost half

decrees.name: Deep Dive
decrees.effect: Pearls from oyster beds

decrees.name: Market Day
decrees.effect: Trade rates +30% at every town
decrees.tradeoff: Traders are known: pirates target them

decrees.name: Sermon
decrees.effect: Fervour +20

decrees.name: Scouts Aloft
decrees.effect: Scouting reports are exact

decrees.name: Egg Watch
decrees.effect: Nests can't be raided; cuckoos fail

decrees.name: Open Skies
decrees.effect: Flocks fly 30% faster

decrees.name: Offerings
decrees.effect: The kraken, the ape, and the pirates ignore you

decrees.name: Brood Day
decrees.effect: Mates lay an extra egg
decrees.tradeoff: Mates are vulnerable (no warming by others)

decrees.name: Guano Harvest
decrees.effect: Guano: twice the harvest
decrees.tradeoff: The island smells: wild mates avoid it today

decrees.name: Lighthouse
decrees.effect: Your island is visible to everyone; traders and mates come from farther

decrees.name: Fog Bank
decrees.effect: Your island is hidden from scouts

decrees.name: Tithe
decrees.effect: Towns pay you 1 pearl per 20 fish traded

decrees.name: Mutiny Watch
decrees.effect: Warriors can't desert even if starving

decrees.name: Thermal Day
decrees.effect: Free altitude over your islands
decrees.tradeoff: Bombers everywhere can use it, including theirs

decrees.name: Salvage
decrees.effect: Every corpse on your grounds is feed
decrees.tradeoff: Scavengers (and their predators) crowd your grounds

decrees.name: Grudge
decrees.effect: +20% damage against the player who last raided you

decrees.name: Hospitality
decrees.effect: Any wild bird that lands joins you
decrees.tradeoff: Any enemy bird that lands is hidden among yours

decrees.name: Day of Rest
decrees.effect: No decree; fervour +5 and birds heal

_perks_source: Doc p38: the Founder levels three times a match, at days 3, 7 and 11, and picks one perk from three offered. Perks are the player's own build and stack with the species.

perks.name: Hooked Beak
perks.effect: Founder attack +30%; the flock the Founder leads +10%

perks.name: Sharp Eyes
perks.effect: The Founder scouts like a Scout at any altitude

perks.name: Loud Voice
perks.effect: Flocks the Founder leads never rout

perks.name: Mother's Instinct
perks.effect: Chicks within sight of the Founder grow 25% faster

perks.name: Pearl Diver
perks.effect: The Founder dives oyster beds without research

perks.name: Weather Sense
perks.effect: Wind shown a day ahead; storms warned a day ahead

perks.name: Nine Lives
perks.effect: One free respawn without the chick-leader penalty

perks.name: Thief's Eye
perks.effect: The Founder sees enemy caches through walls

perks.name: Diplomat
perks.effect: Barter offers from the Founder in person are +20%

perks.name: Old Salt
perks.effect: The Founder's reports include the next day's fish movement

_veterans_source: Doc p42: a warrior that survives three fights becomes a veteran: a name, +15% to its stats, a feather marker, and a trait. Design calls: a fight is an engagement in which it struck or was struck; Fearless gives its flock +15 morale (+30 at most) and never retreats with it; Loyal fights +20% beside the Founder.

traits.name: Keen
traits.effect: sees stealth: silent raids and fog banks

traits.name: Greedy
traits.effect: steals a fish from every kill

traits.name: Loyal
traits.effect: follows the Founder anywhere (+20% beside it)

_mates_source: Doc p43: every mate has one visible trait its chicks inherit as a small bonus; a nest's bowl filled with the trait's favourite fish attracts a mate with that trait.
_relics_source: Doc pp. 46-47. Relics: single items found on dangerous islands; a colony holds at most three, at its shrine; raids on the shrine can steal one. Design calls: until the expansion's islands exist, relics lie at the kraken's cove, skull island's summit, the volcano's rim and the wreck; a raid that reaches a colony's home cache takes a relic one time in four.
_legends_source: Doc p47. One legendary bird per map, by the Visitor event: whoever reaches it first with the right gift (a fish of size 3 or more) recruits it.

legends.name: The Albatross of the South
legends.effect: Your flocks never tire over water

legends.name: The Fisher King
legends.effect: Every ground your colony fishes regrows twice as fast

legends.name: The Old Owl
legends.effect: Every Watcher sees three times as far

legends.name: The Phoenix Chick
legends.effect: Fledges into your best warrior: a veteran Striker

legends.name: The Dodo
legends.effect: Does nothing; worth 200 score if alive at the end, and everyone wants to eat it

_great_source: Doc pp. 46-47: one great event per long match, announced a day ahead to colonies with an Augur. It falls between days 8 and 20.

great_events.name: The Red Tide
great_events.what: A bloom kills a ground's fish and poisons feed for a day; caches with Keepers are safe

great_events.name: The Kraken's Walk
great_events.what: The kraken leaves its cove and crosses the map, eating nests below 20 m; the cove is free for a day

great_events.name: The Great Storm
great_events.what: Two days of gales; the wreck breaks up faster

great_events.name: The Eclipse
great_events.what: A day of night; owls and Shadows own it

great_events.name: The Wreck of the Treasure Ship
great_events.what: A ship sinks near a colony with a hold of pearls; everyone comes

great_events.name: The Plague
great_events.what: A sickness spreads through crowded colonies (over 60 birds); Chemistry 1 or a Nurse per 20 birds cures it

great_events.name: The Calm
great_events.what: No wind for a day; thermals die; Bombers are grounded; fishers reach everything

great_events.name: The Visitor
great_events.what: A legendary bird lands on the map: bring it a fish of size 3 or more to recruit it

_factions_source: Doc p46: three neutral powers on every map of a long match, dealt with by reputation. Design calls: the pirates are a band of 8 that can be fought (its captain falls at 0 HP: the band scatters for four days); a hire lasts a day; the fleet is three boats; the Grey Wings hunt every few hours; tribute buys a day's peace.

techniques.source: doc p48: Fishing mastery. catch multiplies the strike's hit chance; small/big shape it by the fish's size; shore on a ground by an island's shore; risk_k the predators' take; splash the noise; pace the search's speed; recover the seconds after a miss; reach how deep it goes; yield fish per trip; steal a frigatebird's chance on a hover; fight a predator encounter survived. Mastery: each catch +mastery_per_catch (to 1), the hit x(1 + mastery_catch x mastery).

list.name: Plunge
list.how: a straight dive from above 30 m; the strike window is short and strong
list.risk: sharks see the splash; a miss is a 2 s recovery underwater

list.name: Skim
list.how: fly along the surface and snatch
list.best: schools of small fish; the Swift
list.risk: low altitude over a long line: breaches

list.name: Hover-strike
list.how: hold position over a spot and drop
list.best: precision on one fish; crabs and shallows
list.risk: stamina; frigatebirds steal from a hovering bird

list.name: Drive
list.how: several fishers push a school against a shore or a reef, then strike together
list.risk: triple splash; the whole shark population comes

list.name: Deep dive
list.how: swim down (Divers, Penguins, Deep Dive research)
list.best: pearls, deep fish, the kraken's floor
list.risk: a fight instead of a flight if something's there

list.name: Night fishing
list.how: fish the dusk and dawn rises
list.risk: the owls and the Shadows are the only ones it's safe for

nest_styles.source: doc p49: Nest styles. twigs per nest at the base cost of 10 (the founder's bend scales them); eggs the clutch cap (0: the standard); the effects are in NestOpen and StepNestStyles (flight_long.cpp).

list.name: Platform
list.effect: holds 6 eggs; visible from far (egg thieves find it easier)

list.name: Burrow
list.cost: 5 twigs, on sand or soil (low ground)
list.effect: hidden from scouts; floods in storms

list.name: Hanging
list.effect: immune to egg theft, raids and things on the ground; it sways, so Watchers can't perch over it

list.name: Mud
list.effect: fireproof (lava); dissolves in two days of rain

list.name: Cliff ledge
list.cost: 8 twigs and 10 shells, a high site
list.effect: the stack's nest: nothing climbs to it (no theft, no raid, no lizards)

list.name: Floating
list.effect: on the water: immune to everything on land; sharks take from it
